document_data.title: Sports Clearance Document for Taylor Nguyen
document_data.content: This is to certify that Taylor Nguyen, born on 2008-04-12, has undergone a recent check-up and is cleared for participation in sports activities. The patient has a history of asthma and is currently under treatment for major depressive disorder. It is important to note that the patient/guardian has requested that the mental health treatment history not be included in any external summaries. As of the latest visit, the patient's condition is stable. Please consult the patient's healthcare provider for any further information or concerns.
